resources.string: On the CarPlay iPhone, turn on Personal Hotspot and Allow Others to Join. Connect the head unit to it in system Wi-Fi settings, save its name and password below, and select that iPhone over Bluetooth. This mode needs testing with your iOS version. Changes apply at the next connection.

Keep Personal Hotspot enabled on the selected CarPlay iPhone and connect the head unit to it. Check the saved name and password and retry. Save a diagnostic report if CarPlay still fails; this mode is experimental.
